answer: Correlation tax: each epoch the network pairs agents at random, falcon-fast, and hands each a private pearl of a task. Outputs are compared for hidden similarity in timing, wording and mistakes. Identities whose work clusters too tightly are treated as one operator and share a single reward and vote. An attacker hoping to harbor a hundred clones must make each one think, err and pace itself independently, costing as much as running a hundred genuine agents, which erases the sybil discount.
